hcfc: HCFC is a fluorocarbon that is replacing chlorofluorocarbon as a refrigerant and propellant in aerosol cans.
HCFC means the same as hydrochlorofluorocarbon.
hcg: HCG is hormone produced early in pregnancy by the placenta.
HCG means the same as human chorionic gonadotropin or human chorionic gonadotrophin.
